901: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Sing the songs of the Lord's praises.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ. ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeating the Name, supreme peace is obtained, and coming and going ends, my friend. ॥1॥ Rahao
Singing His praises, light dawns within,
and the mind dwells at His lotus feet. ॥1॥
In the saints' company one is saved;
Nanak, you will cross the terrifying world-ocean. ॥2॥1॥57॥
My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeating the Lord's Name one is ever at peace, and all the diseases of falsehood are destroyed. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
in whose refuge there is ever peace. ॥1॥
ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ; ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
Sleep becomes peaceful when hunger for the Name arises;
remembering the Lord, all sorrows are destroyed. ॥2॥
Enjoy bliss in poise, my brother;
the perfect Guru has erased all anxiety. ॥3॥
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
At all hours chant the chant of God;
Nanak, He Himself has become the protector. ॥4॥2॥58॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Bow in reverence to the Lord of all beings,
ਜਲਨ ਥਲਨ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨ; ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the One all-pervading Lord in water, on land, on earth and in the sky. ॥1॥ Rahao
He destroys, sustains and creates again and again;
He has no home and needs no food. ॥1॥
ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ; ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
He is deep, steadfast, His Name a diamond; He is lofty, great and infinite.
ਕਰਨ ਕੇਲ. ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
He performs all plays, His virtues are priceless; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ॥2॥1॥59॥
ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਭੋਗ, ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੇ. ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beauty, colours, fragrances and pleasures are left behind as people depart, deceived by Maya, by gold and women. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਰਬ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ; ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੈ ॥
Seeing the play of storehouses of wealth in millions and billions, the mind takes comfort,
but they do not go along. ॥1॥
ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ, ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ; ਇਹ ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਮਨੀ ॥
Entangled with son, wife, brother and friend, one is bewitched by doubt and attachment; these are like the shade of a tree.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੦॥
Nanak, the peace of the refuge of the Lord's lotus feet is dear to the saints. ॥2॥2॥60॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਓਟ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
O mind, take the shelter of the Lord's Name,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੈ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remembering which evil thinking is destroyed, and you will attain the state free of desire. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੋ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Know that person to be very fortunate who sings the Lord's praises;
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ; ਫੁਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
ridding himself of the sins of many births, he then goes to heaven. ॥1॥
902: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਕਉ. ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
At the very end, Ajamal came to remember the Lord,
ਜਾਂ ਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਬਾਛਤ; ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
and in an instant attained the state that great yogis long for. ॥2॥
ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ. ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ; ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ. ਗਜਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
The elephant had no virtue and no learning; what religious deeds had it done?
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Nanak, see the innate way of the Lord: He gave it the gift of fearlessness. ॥3॥1॥
O saints, what way should now be followed,
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by which all evil thinking is destroyed and the mind is drenched in devotion to the Lord? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ. ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
The mind is entangled in Maya and understands nothing of wisdom.
ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ; ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
What is that Name, remembering which the world attains the state free of desire? ॥1॥
ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ; ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
When the saints became kind and merciful, they told this:
ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਏ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
whoever has sung God's praises, know that he has performed all religious duties. ॥2॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
The man who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart even for an instant, night or day,
ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ. ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ; ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
Nanak, his fear of Death is erased and he makes his life fruitful. ॥3॥2॥
O mortal, keep the Lord in your awareness.
ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ; ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Moment by moment, night and day, your life is ebbing away; your body is passing in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਓ; ਬਾਲਪਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
You lost your youth in sensual pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.
ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ. ਸਮਝੈ; ਕਉਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਉਰਝਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Now you are old, and still you do not understand; in what evil thinking are you entangled? ॥1॥
ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ; ਸੋ ਤੈ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
Why have you forgotten the Master who gave you human birth?
ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਰ. ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ; ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Remembering Him, man is liberated, yet you have not sung His praises even for an instant. ॥2॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
Why are you proud of Maya? It goes with no one.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੁ. ਚੇਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ; ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥੮੧॥
Nanak says: remember the Lord, the wish-fulfilling jewel; He will be your helper in the end. ॥3॥3॥81॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਹਿ ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
The same moon rises, the same stars, the same sun shines,
ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ. ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ; ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ ਖੇਲੇ. ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
the same earth, the same wind blows; the age plays out in the hearts of beings, not in places. ॥1॥
Give up selfish craving for life.
ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ; ਕਲਿ ਲਖਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who oppress others think their oppression approved; know these to be the marks of the dark age. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਿਤੈ ਦੇਸਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ; ਤੀਰਥ ਪਾਸਿ. ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
No one has heard that the dark age has come to some land or sits by some pilgrim place;
ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ. ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਹਲ ਉਸਾਰਿ. ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥੨॥
it is not where the giver gives alms, nor has it built a mansion and sat in it. ॥2॥
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੇ, ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ; ਤਪ ਘਰਿ ਤਪੁ, ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
If one practises truth, he is put down; the penitent's senses are not in his control;
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ. ਬਦਨਾਵੀ; ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਏਈ ॥੩॥
if one takes the Name, he is defamed: these are the marks of the dark age. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ. ਤਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ; ਚਾਕਰ ਕੇਹੇ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
The one who has power over others is himself ruined in the end; what need have servants to fear?
ਜਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ਪਵੈ ਜੰਜੀਰੀ; ਤਾ ਚਾਕਰ ਹਥਹੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
When the chain falls on the chief's neck, he dies at the hands of those servants. ॥4॥
903: Sing His virtues, now that the dark age has come.
ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ. ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ; ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਹਿ. ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The sway of the three ages is over; if You grant virtues, they are obtained. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ. ਸਰਾ ਨਿਬੇੜੀ; ਕਾਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
In the dark age, strife-breeding law decides, and the Kazi, the judge, takes bribes.
ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ; ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੫॥
The Atharva Veda of spells is Brahma's prevailing word; good conduct and praise have departed. ॥5॥
ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ. ਸਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਜਤ ਵਿਣੁ. ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ ॥
What is worship without the Master, discipline without truth, the sacred thread without chastity?
ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜਾਵਹੁ; ਸੁਚ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੋਚ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
You bathe and wash and apply the frontal mark, but without inner purity there is no purity. ॥6॥
In the dark age the Semitic scriptures and the Quran are approved by force;
the pandits' books and Puranas are set aside;
Nanak, the Lord's Name has become Rahman.
Know that the One Creator does all this. ॥7॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਏਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
Nanak, through the Name comes honour; there is no deed higher than this.
ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ. ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਫਿਰਿ ਓਲਾਮਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
If, though the Lord is in one's own home, one goes begging elsewhere, then the blame falls on him. ॥8॥1॥
You preach to the world and fatten your body on the alms you beg.
Abandoning steadiness of mind, how can you find the True Lord?
The one attached to possessiveness and Maya, fond of women,
is neither a renunciate nor a householder. ॥1॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹਹੁ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
O yogi, sit still with your mind on the Lord, and the pain of duality will flee;
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਤ; ਲਾਜ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
you will not have to suffer the shame of begging from house to house. ॥1॥ Rahao
You sing songs, but do not examine your own self;
how can the burning fire within be quenched?
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
The one absorbed with love in the Guru's Word,
with understanding of poise, eats the alms of the Name. ॥2॥
Smearing your body with ashes you practise hypocrisy;
in attachment to Maya you suffer Death's punishment.
When the begging bowl of the heart is broken, the alms of love cannot stay in it;
bound in bonds, one comes and goes. ॥3॥
You do not restrain lust, yet you call yourself celibate;
begging for Maya you are lured by the three qualities.
In the merciless heart the Lord's light does not shine;
sinking and sinking, one drowns in all the entanglements. ॥4॥
You wear religious garb and a patched coat with much display,
but like a juggler you play a false show.
The one burnt within by the fire of craving and much anxiety,
without the Lord's grace, how can he cross over? ॥5॥
You have made earrings of glass and put them in your ears,
but without understanding of spiritual wisdom there is no liberation.
The one lured by the taste of the tongue and the senses
has become a beast; this mark cannot be erased. ॥6॥
As worldly people are caught in the three qualities, so are such yogis;
the one who reflects on the Word is rid of sorrow.
He alone is pure in whom the True One and His Word dwell;
he alone is a yogi who understands the true way. ॥7॥
ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ; ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
O Lord, the nine treasures are with You; You are able to do all.
You create and destroy; whatever You do comes to pass.
The one within whom the True One dwells has chastity, truth, discipline and a pure heart;
Nanak, such a yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ॥8॥2॥
The body with its six chakras has become my monastery, and my mind is detached;
the Word has entered my awareness, and love for the Name has awakened within.
The unceasing Word resounds, and my mind is absorbed in it.
Through the Guru's word, my mind is at one with the True Name. ॥1॥
O mortal, through devotion to the Lord peace is found.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Turning to the Guru, the Lord seems sweet, and one merges in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
904: Holding back attachment to Maya, one merges in the Name,
when one meets the True Guru, who unites one in his company.
The Name is a jewel, a priceless diamond;
dyed in it, my mind is steady. ॥2॥
The disease of ego and possessiveness does not cling;
ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
through devotion to the Lord the fear of Death flees.
Terrible Death does not touch me,
for the Lord's pure Name adorns my heart. ॥3॥
Reflecting on the Word, one becomes the Formless Lord's own;
through the Guru's teaching one awakens, and evil thinking is cast out.
Those who stay awake day and night with their attention fixed on Him
attain within the state of liberation while living. ॥4॥
In the cave of the body they stay unattached and apart;
through the Word they kill the five thieves.
ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ; ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ ॥
Their mind does not waver toward another's home;
I stay absorbed in poise without a break. ॥5॥
The true renunciate, turning to the Guru, stays awake;
ever detached, he keeps the Essence strung in his heart.
The world sleeps, dies and comes and goes;
without the Guru's Word it gains no understanding. ॥6॥
The unceasing Word resounds day and night
for the one who, turning to the Guru, knows the state of the Unseen Lord.
He knows Him only when he recognises Him through the Word:
the One desireless Lord pervades all. ॥7॥
The mind is dyed in poise, in the trance free of Maya's thoughts;
giving up ego and greed, it knows the One alone.
The disciple's mind is at one with the Guru;
Nanak, erasing duality, he merges in the Lord. ॥8॥3॥
O pandit, you calculate auspicious dates but do not reflect
that the One Lord is above all auspicious times.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
The one who meets the Guru knows the way;
when one has the Guru's teaching, one recognises His will. ॥1॥
ਝੂਠੁ. ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਾਡੇ; ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
O pandit, do not speak falsehood; speak the truth.
ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When ego departs through the Word, one finds the true home. ॥1॥ Rahao
Calculating and calculating, the astrologer draws up the horoscope;
he reads it and recites it, but does not recognise the essence.
Above all, reflect on the Guru's Word;
ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਉ ਨ; ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
I care for no other talk; all else is dust. ॥2॥
You bathe and wash and worship stones,
but without being dyed in the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.
Casting out pride, one meets God, the Charioteer of life;
meditate on the Lord, who liberates the soul and fulfils life. ॥3॥
He reads disputations and does not reflect on the Vedas;
drowning himself, how can he save his ancestors?
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
A rare person recognises the Lord in every heart;
when one meets the True Guru, understanding comes. ॥4॥
As one keeps reckoning auspicious times, the soul suffers from anxiety;
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ ॥
when one falls into the Guru's refuge, there is peace.
Even after committing faults, when we came to His refuge,
the Lord let us meet the Guru according to our past deeds. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ. ਨ ਆਈਐ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Without coming to the Guru's refuge, the Lord is not found;
led astray by doubt, one dies and is born again.
Bound at Death's door, one dies in vain,
ਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
with neither the Name in the heart nor the Word nor good conduct. ॥6॥
Some call themselves Padhas, Pandits and Misars,
but dyed in duality, they do not find the Lord's mansion.
905: The one who by the Guru's grace has the Name as his support
is a rare one among millions, incomparable. ॥7॥
In bad and good alike, the One True Lord is present;
O seeker of wisdom, understand this with the support of the True Guru.
Rare are those who, turning to the Guru, have known the One;
ending their coming and going, they merge in Him. ॥8॥
Those in whose hearts the One Lord dwells
keep the True Lord, Master of all virtues, ever in their reflection.
The one who does his deeds in the Guru's will,
Nanak, merges in the Truest of the true. ॥9॥4॥
Through stubborn restraint the body only wastes away;
ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
through fasting and austerity the mind is not softened.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
O mind, serve the Guru and keep the company of the Lord's servants.
ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ. ਜੋਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ; ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ, ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Drink the relish of the Lord, and terrible Death cannot touch you, nor the serpent of Maya bite you. ॥1॥ Rahao
The world reads disputations and delights in pleasures,
and caught in the poison of the three qualities, it is born and dies.
Without the Lord's Name one suffers pain. ॥2॥
The yogi draws up his breath until his seat is soaked with sweat;
he performs the bowel-cleansing and the six practices of hatha yoga;
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
but without the Lord's Name, every breath he draws is in vain. ॥3॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ; ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥
With the five fires burning within, how can the mind be patient?
With the thief within, how can bliss be tasted?
Turning to the Guru, conquer the fortress of the body. ॥4॥
With filth within, one wanders to pilgrim places,
ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਚਾ; ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
but the mind is not pure; what use is ritual bathing?
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ; ਦੋਸੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
Past deeds drive one on; whom can one blame? ॥5॥
ਅੰਨੁ. ਨ ਖਾਹਿ; ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Those who eat no grain only torment the body;
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਥੀਜੈ ॥
without the Guru's wisdom there is no contentment.
The self-willed is born and dies, born and dies again. ॥6॥
Taking the True Guru's counsel, keep the company of the Lord's servants;
ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੈ; ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
then the mind is absorbed in the Lord, and one is not born to die again.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
Without the Lord's Name, what good is any deed? ॥7॥
Cast out the noisy mouse-like chatter of the mind,
and dwell on the Lord; this is the service ordained from the start.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
Nanak prays: O God, be merciful, so that I may receive the Name. ॥8॥5॥
The power of creation is within Him; there is no other.
ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Whatever is named has come from God.
Through all the ages He alone is the True Master;
there is no other who creates and destroys. ॥1॥
Such is my Master, deep and profound.
ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ, ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever has meditated on Him has found peace; through the Lord's Name, Death's arrow does not strike. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Name is a jewel, a priceless diamond;
the True Master is immortal and immeasurable.
Pure is the tongue that utters His true praise;
within and without, the True One alone is seen, without confusion. ॥2॥
ਇਕਿ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ; ਡੂਗਰਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
Some sit in the forests, some make their dwelling on mountains;
forgetting the Name, they waste away in pride.
Without the Name, what use is wisdom or meditation?
Those who turn to the Guru receive honour in His court. ॥3॥
The one who practises stubborn discipline with pride does not find Him;
he reads the scriptures and recites them to people,
906: he wanders to pilgrim places, but his disease does not depart;
without the Name, how can he find peace? ॥4॥
ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ; ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਿਵੈ. ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
He makes efforts, yet in no way can lust be held back;
the mind wavers and is cast into hell;
bound in the city of Death, it receives punishment;
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
without the Name, the soul burns and burns. ॥5॥
So many siddhas, seekers, sages and gods,
through stubborn restraint, cannot still the restlessness within.
Those who reflect on the Word and take up the Guru's service
become pure in mind and body, and pride leaves them. ॥6॥
The one whom the Lord meets in His grace receives the True Name.
O Lord, I stay in Your refuge, seeking the sublime love of Your feet.
Devotion and love spring from You.
Turning to the Guru, may I chant the chant of the Lord's Name. ॥7॥
When the mind is drenched in the Name, ego and pride depart;
this is not obtained through falsehood or by practising hypocrisy.
Without the Guru's Word the Lord's door is not found;
Nanak, the one who turns to the Guru meets the Root of all and reflects on His virtues. ॥8॥6॥
ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ. ਤਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਬਉਰੇ; ਜਿਉ ਜਨਮੇ. ਤਿਉ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
O mad one, as you came, so you will go; as you were born, so you will die.
ਜਿਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ. ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ. ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
As much as you enjoy pleasures, so much pain clings to you; forgetting the Name, you have fallen into the terrifying world-ocean. ॥1॥
Beholding your body and wealth, you are swollen with pride.
ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਉ. ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਹਿ; ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ. ਭਰਮਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You increase your love for gold and women; why do you forget the Name and stray in doubt? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੀਲੁ. ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
You have not kept chastity, truth, discipline or good nature; in the impure skeleton of the body you have become hard as wood.
ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਬਾਦਿ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥
You have no charity, giving, purity or restraint; without the holy company your life goes in vain. ॥2॥
ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ; ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Caught in greed you have forgotten the Name, and your life passes in running to and fro.
ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
When Death rushes in, seizes you by the hair and strikes you, in the jaws of death you will have no awareness of the Name. ॥3॥
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
Day and night you slander and envy others; in your heart there is neither the Name nor compassion for all.
ਬਿਨੁ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦ. ਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
Without the Guru's Word you will find neither salvation nor honour; without the Lord's Name you have fallen into hell. ॥4॥
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਟੂਆ ਜਿਉ; ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Like an actor you change your guise in an instant; you are sunk in attachment and sin.
ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ; ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
Seeing Maya spread here and there, you are intoxicated with attachment to it. ॥5॥
ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਥਾਰ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ. ਭਰਮਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
You commit vices and spread out countless entanglements; without attention to the Word you stray in doubt.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ. ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
The disease of ego, a great pain, afflicts you; take the Guru's teaching, and the disease will go. ॥6॥
ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖੈ; ਸਾਕਤ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
When the faithless see comforts and wealth coming, pride arises in their minds;
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ. ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਵੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
but the One to whom this body and wealth belong takes them back, and anxiety and pain settle within. ॥7॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
At the last moment nothing goes along; all that is seen is His gift.
ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ. ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੮॥
God is the Primal Being, beyond the beyond; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, one crosses over. ॥8॥
ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ. ਕਿਸਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ; ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
You weep for the dead; to whom do you cry? You have fallen into the dreadful, terrifying ocean.
ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥
Seeing family, wealth, home and mansions, the faithless is caught in a worthless web. ॥9॥
907: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ; ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
When we came, He sent us; when we depart, He has called us back.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Whatever He wills to do, He does; the Forgiver forgives. ॥10॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
In the company of those who have tasted this elixir of the Lord, this secret is understood.
ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Wealth, powers, wisdom and true understanding come from the Guru; in his refuge the treasure of liberation, the Name, is found. ॥11॥
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ; ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Turning to the Guru, one knows pain and pleasure as alike, and stays detached from joy and sorrow.
ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
Killing self-conceit and turning to the Guru, one finds the Lord; Nanak, He absorbs him in poise. ॥12॥7॥
ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
My Guru has made firm in me chastity, high conduct, restraint and remembrance of the True One; he stays absorbed in the relish of the true Word. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
My Guru is merciful, ever absorbed in love.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Day and night his attention stays fixed on the One; beholding the True One, he is content. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ. ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ; ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
He dwells in the high, steady realm, his gaze alike on all; he is dyed in the unceasing Word. ॥2॥
ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
Wearing the loincloth of good conduct, he is absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; his tongue is steeped in His love. ॥3॥
ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ. ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ; ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
The unerring Guru is ever united with the One who made the creation; beholding His work, he is content in faith. ॥4॥
ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ. ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ; ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
All are in the One, and the One is in all; the True Guru has seen this and shown it to me. ॥5॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
The God who made the continents, worlds and galaxies cannot be described. ॥6॥
ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
From his own lamp the Guru has lit the lamp within me, and shown me the Light that pervades the three worlds. ॥7॥
ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
Seated on the true throne in the true mansion, he has entered a trance free of fear. ॥8॥
ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
The detached yogi, my Guru, has enchanted the world; he has played the lute of spiritual life within every heart. ॥9॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
Nanak, the True Lord is the Guru's friend; through the Guru, in God's refuge, beings are set free. ॥10॥8॥
ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ; ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ, ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
The Lord who holds up earth and sky by His power dwells in the heart and makes the body His home. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O saints, through the Guru's Word, turning beings to the Guru, He has saved countless people. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
O Lord, the one You save kills possessiveness and dries up ego, and sees Your Light throughout the three worlds. ॥2॥
ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ. ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Through reflection on the True Guru's Word, he kills desire and keeps Your remembrance in his mind. ॥3॥
ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
His awareness rests in the Undying One; this is the horn that sounds; in every heart he sees Your Light. ॥4॥
ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ, ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
He keeps his mind on the One in whom the lute of creation plays, and kindles the divine Light within. ॥5॥
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ. ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Having gained this body of five elements, day and night he keeps lit the lamp of the pure, infinite Light. ॥6॥
ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ, ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ; ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
He makes this body the lute and each breath of the Name its gourds; within him the Word plays with a wondrous pull. ॥7॥
ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ; ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
O yogi, his seat is in the city of the Blissful Lord, where the unseen, unreachable, infinite One is revealed. ॥8॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ; ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
The body becomes a living city, where this mind is king and the five senses dwell with wisdom. ॥9॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ; ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
Strong upon his seat, dwelling in his own home, he remembers the Lord through the Word; he does justice and does good to others. ॥10॥
ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ; ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
Dying while alive, he has subdued his mind; then what can poor birth and death do to him? ॥11॥
908: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
He understands that the Creator alone does all; Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are forms of the One. ॥12॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
Keeping the Lord of all souls in his thought and purifying his body, he crosses the world-ocean. ॥13॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
Through the service shown by the Guru he has found lasting peace; the virtue-giving Word stays within him. ॥14॥
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
The Giver of virtues Himself unites him with the holy, and kills his ego and thirst. ॥15॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ. ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ; ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
He erases the hold of the three qualities and dwells in the fourth state; this devotion alone draws him. ॥16॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ. ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
Through the yoga of the Guru's Word, the one turned to the Guru examines his own soul, and keeps the One Lord in his heart. ॥17॥
ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ; ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
His mind, dyed in the Word, stays steady; this he finds the most excellent deed. ॥18॥
ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ. ਅਉਧੂ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
O yogi, he does not take to debate over the Vedas, seeing it as hypocrisy; turning to the Guru, through the Word he gains true understanding. ॥19॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ; ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
O yogi, he walks the Guru's way; this is the yoga he practises; reflecting on the Word is his chastity and truth. ॥20॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
O yogi, he has understood the way of union: through the Word he dies to self and keeps his mind in check. ॥21॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ; ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
O yogi, attachment to Maya is a whirlpool; through the Word he crosses it and carries his family across too. ॥22॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ. ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ; ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
O yogi, those attached to the Word are heroes in all four ages; through the Guru's bani they keep devotion in their thoughts. ॥23॥
ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ; ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
O yogi, this mind is enticed by Maya; it escapes by reflecting on the Lord's praise through the Word. ॥24॥
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
He Himself forgives and unites in His company; Nanak prays: O Lord, I have come to Your refuge. ॥25॥9॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
O yogi, wear earrings of earnest effort in your ears, and make compassion your patched coat.
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
O yogi, rub on the ashes of fear of coming and going; then you have conquered the three worlds. ॥1॥
O yogi, play such a lute,
ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by whose playing the unceasing bliss arises, and one stays attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
O yogi, make service and contentment your begging bowl and bag; put the ambrosial Name in it as your food.
ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ; ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
O yogi, make meditation on the Lord your staff, and sound the horn of awareness fixed on Him. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ, ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
O yogi, make your mind firm and sit in this posture; then your mind's torment will go.
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ, ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
O yogi, if you go begging within the city of the body, then you will gain the Name. ॥3॥
ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
O yogi, with this lute attention is not fixed on the Lord, nor is the True One gained.
ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
O yogi, with this lute peace does not come, nor does pride leave from within. ॥4॥
ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ, ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
O yogi, make this body the lute's neck, and fix to it the two gourds of fear and love of God.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
If you turn to the Guru, the string will sound, and in this way thirst is destroyed. ॥5॥
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ. ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ; ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
One who understands the Lord's Command and fixes the mind on the One is called a yogi.
ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ. ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
His dread is broken, he becomes pure, and so he finds the way of union. ॥6॥
ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
All that comes into sight will perish; fix your mind on the Lord.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
When your faith is joined with the True Guru, then this understanding comes. ॥7॥
909: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਜਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿ, ਪਰਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
O yogi, this is not yoga, that you leave your family and wander through lands.
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹਹਿ ॥੮॥
The Lord's Name dwells in the house of the body; by the Guru's grace you will find your Lord God there. ॥8॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਜੋਗੀ; ਇਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
O yogi, this world is a puppet of clay; in it is the great disease of thirst for Maya.
ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਗੀ; ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
O yogi, though one makes countless efforts and wears religious garbs, the disease is not removed. ॥9॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
O yogi, the Lord's Name is the medicine, but only for the one in whose mind He places it.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥
Only the one who turns to the Guru understands, and finds the way of union. ॥10॥
ਜੋਗੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
O yogi, the path of yoga is hard; only the one on whom He casts His gracious glance finds it.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
He sees the One alone, within and without, and removes doubt from within. ॥11॥
ਵਿਣੁ ਵਜਾਈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਸਾ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
O yogi, play that lute which plays without being played.
ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
Says Nanak: O yogi, you will be liberated, and remain absorbed in the True One. ॥12॥1॥10॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
The one who turns to the Guru knows the treasure of devotion; the True Guru, understanding it himself, has made it understood. ॥1॥
O saints, the Lord gives honour to the one who turns to the Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ. ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Remain in the True One, and poise and peace will ever arise, and lust and anger will leave from within. ॥2॥
ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Giving up self-conceit, he is attuned to the Name, and has burnt away possessiveness through the Word. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ. ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
We perish by the One from whom we arise; at the end only the Name is our companion. ॥4॥
ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ. ਦੂਰਿ, ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੫॥
The One who made this creation is ever present; do not think Him far away. ॥5॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
The true Word of praise dwells in the heart, and one is attuned to the True One. ॥6॥
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ; ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੭॥
In the true company is the priceless Name; it is found by great good fortune. ॥7॥
ਭਰਮਿ. ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥੮॥
Do not stray in doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind in one place. ॥8॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸਭ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
Without the Name the whole world wanders astray and wastes its life in vain. ॥9॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੰਢੈ; ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Through hypocrisy, union is not attained; the yogi has lost the way and wanders aimlessly. ॥10॥
ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Through the Guru's Word he attains union, and is seated in the city of the Blissful Lord, the holy company. ॥11॥
ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ. ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
Through the Word he ends the play of running after Maya, and the Name comes to dwell in his mind. ॥12॥
ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
O saints, this body is a pool; the one who stays attuned to the Lord bathes in it. ॥13॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਸਬਦੇ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Those who bathe in the Name are pure; through the Word they have washed away their filth. ॥14॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ. ਨਾਮੁ, ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Through the three qualities they are heedless and do not remember the Name; without the Name, all die spiritually. ॥15॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, the three forms, are led astray in doubt by the three qualities. ॥16॥
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ; ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
By the Guru's grace the frown of the three is removed, and one is attuned in the fourth state. ॥17॥
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਤਿੰਨਾ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
The pandits read and, having read, expound quarrels; they gain no understanding. ॥18॥
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ; ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
Intoxicated with Maya, they are led astray by doubt; whom then can they teach, O brother? ॥19॥
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
The word of the Lord's devotees is sublime; in every age it holds its sway. ॥20॥
ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ; ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
One who attaches himself to the bani attains the highest state; through the Word he merges in the True One. ॥21॥
910: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
One who searches the city of the body through the Word finds the Name, the nine treasures. ॥22॥
ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ. ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
Killing desire, his mind merges in poise; turning the tongue from worldly tastes, he sings the Lord's praise. ॥23॥
ਲੋਇਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ; ਚਿਤੁ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
His eyes behold the Wondrous Lord everywhere, and his mind is fixed on the Unseen. ॥24॥
ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
His light is merged in the Light of the Unseen One, who stays ever detached. ॥25॥
ਹਉ. ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
I ever praise my own Guru, who has given me understanding of the True One. ॥26॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੭॥੨॥੧੧॥
Nanak makes this one prayer: through the Name come the highest state and honour. ॥27॥2॥11॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
O saints, the Lord's worship is hard to obtain; nothing can be said of it. ॥1॥
O saints, the one who turns to the Guru finds the Perfect Lord.
The Guru has us worship through the Name alone. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ. ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
O saints, without the Lord everything is filthy; what can I offer to Him in worship? ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
Whatever pleases the True Lord is worship; the one turned to the Guru enshrines His Will in the mind. ॥3॥
ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
O saints, all the world performs worship, but that of the self-willed is not accepted. ॥4॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
O saints, one who dies through the Word has a pure mind; this worship is accepted. ॥5॥
ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ; ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
Those people are pure and holy and become one with the True One; through the Word they are attuned to the One. ॥6॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ. ਨ ਹੋਵੀ; ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੭॥
Without the Name no other worship is possible; the world strays in doubt. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
O saints, the one turned to the Guru examines himself, and is attuned to the Lord's Name. ॥8॥
ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੯॥
The Pure One Himself has us worship Him, and through the Guru's Word He accepts it. ॥9॥
ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
They perform worship, but do not know the way; in love of duality they stay smeared with filth. ॥10॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ; ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
One who turns to the Guru knows true worship, and enshrines the Lord's Will in his mind. ॥11॥
ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਅੰਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
O saints, through accepting His Will one obtains all comforts, and at the end the Name is his companion. ॥12॥
ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੩॥
O saints, those who do not examine themselves, caught in falsehood, glorify themselves. ॥13॥
ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ਜਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ; ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Death does not spare those who practise hypocrisy; it will take them away, stripped of honour. ॥14॥
ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ; ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Those within whom the Word dwells examine themselves; they alone know the Lord's state and extent. ॥15॥
ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Their mind enters the trance where no thoughts of Maya arise, and their light merges in the Light. ॥16॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Those who turn to the Guru meet in the true company; hearing the Name again and again, they chant it. ॥17॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
The one turned to the Guru sings His praise, sheds his ego, and gains glory at the True Court. ॥18॥
ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
He utters the true bani, speaks the True Name, and stays attuned to the True Name. ॥19॥
ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ. ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
My God, Destroyer of fear and Eradicator of the worst sins, is our companion at the end. ॥20॥
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੩॥੧੨॥
He Himself pervades all; Nanak, glory comes through the Name. ॥21॥3॥12॥
ਹਮ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ. ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਬਦੇ. ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
O saints, we are filthy, foul-natured and very proud; joining with the Word, the filth is removed. ॥1॥
O saints, turning to the Guru, one is carried across through the Name.
ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one within whose heart the True Name dwells, the Creator Himself has adorned. ॥1॥ Rahao
